notes.title: June and Good Fortune
notes.content:
[b]Lewd Digital[/b] is launching our biggest content update to date for [i][b]Naked Erotic Dance Girls[/b][/i]!

To celebrate the Lunar New Year, meet [i]June[/i] and her [i]Good Fortune[/i] dance stage.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/mgZfRxSb/2021-02-09-June-001.png[/img]

June can be used in all other dance environments, as well as all previous characters can dance at the new location.

Achievements have been added as well for choosing June as your dance and for selecting the Good Fortune stage respectively.

In addition to the new character and environment, there are many more updates and improvements to discuss. These include:

[list]
[*]New dance move motion capture performances
[*]Mirroring of all dance moves to add more variety to new and existing dance moves
[*]10 new music tracks
[*]Improved character rig (June only for now)
[*]Experimental dynamic hair (June only for now)
[/list]

One of the more requested recommendations we have received since launching is more bustier characters. We listened and created June with you in mind. Charlene is quite chesty as well, but her character rig doesn't articulate the motion as well for a person of this stature. Therefore we made improvements to the base character rig to be able to add in more motion to the breast. Without getting into too many details, perhaps this will showcase the improvements more easily:

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/DwWVmrRD/2021-01-27-Juicy-001.gif[/img]

The plan is to go back eventually and upgrade existing characters with this new rig. Hopefully (fingers crossed) it is a quick and smooth process that doesn't end up breaking existing character configurations.

We hope you enjoy. Wishing you lots of luck and happiness in the year ahead. Happy Lunar New Year!

notes.title: Erika and the Ice Box
notes.content:
[b]Lewd Digital[/b] is pleased to announce our first major content update for [i][b]Naked Erotic Dance Girls[/b][/i]!

Say hello to [i]Erika[/i], our Scandinavian Ice Queen. Watch her heat things up with her moves and extra cozy muff on top of the new [i]Ice Box[/i] dance stage.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZYjwbSsP/2021-01-26-Erika-Promo-No-Text.png[/img]

Erika can be used in all other dance environments, as well as all previous characters can dance at the new location.

Achievements have been added as well for choosing Erika as your dance and for selecting the Ice Box stage respectively.

Thank you all for your patience once again. This update was intended to be completed a while back, but life got a little crazy for us. We hope you enjoy the new content at the very least. Additional content is currently under production including new music and motion captured dance moves. But to have you all not wait for one giant update, [b]Lewd Digital[/b] decided to roll changes in smaller pieces.

Have fun!

notes.title: Wrapping Up 2020
notes.content:
Happy holidays! [b]Lewd Digital[/b] is hoping you all are able to enjoy some time off to relax and recharge as we come up to another year.

We do apologize for having been so quiet for the last month. We have had to make some larger changes and adapt to new regional COVID-19 regulations as well as deal with some personal book keeping items. Not to worry though. [b]Lewd Digital[/b] is doing fine and we are gearing up once again.

Originally the plan was to release a decent sized content update by now. As mentioned above, some other things delayed us for the time being. That said, the content is still on its way and nearing completion. The new plan as well is to release parts of it as they are completed as to not keep you waiting any longer. Keep an eye out over the next week or so for some fresh content.

Other than that, [b]Lewd Digital[/b] is eagerly looking forward to the New Year as we have plans for additional content for [b][i]Naked Erotic Dance Girls[/i][/b] and possible ideas for our next project.

notes.title: Thank You!
notes.content:
[b]Lewd Digital[/b] would like to thank everyone who has purchased [i][b]Naked Erotic Dance Girls[/b][/i]. The game's launch has been very exciting for us and we are very happy to see so many users enjoying it.

We have been keeping busy with continuing to develop content for [i][b]Naked Erotic Dance Girls[/b][/i] which should be coming sooner than later. Not that we want to spoil too much about it beforehand, but you can expect a new dancer, environment, music, and dance sequences. 

We've also been trying to incorporate some of the community feedback we have received inside the discussions forum.

In addition, we are also working on releasing a public survey to better help us focus on new content for [i][b]Naked Erotic Dance Girls[/b][/i] and beyond. Keep an eye out in the discussions and news for any announcements.

notes.title: Naked Erotic Dance Girls Now Available!
notes.content:
[i][b]Naked Erotic Dance Girls[/b][/i] is now finally live and available for purchase on Steam!

Thank you all for your patience as there were some unforeseen delays with the review process. We are certain though that the wait will be well worth it.

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Release Date
notes.content:
[i][b]Naked Erotic Dance Girls[/b][/i] is nearing release. The original release date was missed as it seems like COVID-19 has slowed down some of the review process.

We did hear back and had to make one small change (which is completed). The game has been re-submitted and hopefully will be live sooner than later.

We at [b]Lewd Digital[/b] appreciate your patience. We are certain the wait will be well worth it 😉

notes.title: Possible Release Delay
notes.content:
[b][i]Naked Erotic Dance Girls[/i][/b] may be delayed as its product review is taking longer than anticipated. Please be patient as we wait to hear back — Don't worry, these girls aren't going anywhere without you 😉

Perhaps there is still potential for the game to release on its scheduled date of October 1st, 2020. If we don't hear back by the end of day tomorrow, the release will be pushed back another week to the following Thursday, on October 8th, 2020.

In the meantime, I have gone ahead and added some achievements to the game. There are also plans for additional dancers, stages, music, and dance routines still to come.
